changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition ADD COLUMN rule_id BIGINT; UPDATE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition c SET rule_id = r.id FROM stop_factors.stop_factor_rule r WHERE r.stop_factor_id = c.stop_factor_id; ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition ALTER COLUMN rule_id SET NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT fk_stop_factor_condition_rule FOREIGN KEY (rule_id) REFERENCES stop_factors.stop_factor_rule (id), DROP CONSTRAINT uq_stop_factor_condition_stop_factor_result, ADD CONSTRAINT uq_stop_factor_condition_rule_result UNIQUE (rule_id, result), DROP CONSTRAINT fk_stop_factor_condition_stop_factor, DROP COLUMN stop_factor_id;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition ADD COLUMN stop_factor_id BIGINT; UPDATE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition c SET stop_factor_id = r.stop_factor_id FROM stop_factors.stop_factor_rule r WHERE r.id = c.rule_id; ALTER TABLE stop_factors.stop_factor_condition ALTER COLUMN stop_factor_id SET NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT fk_stop_factor_condition_stop_factor FOREIGN KEY (stop_factor_id) REFERENCES stop_factors.stop_factor (id), DROP CONSTRAINT uq_stop_factor_condition_rule_result, ADD CONSTRAINT uq_stop_factor_condition_stop_factor_result UNIQUE (stop_factor_id, result), DROP CONSTRAINT fk_stop_factor_condition_rule, DROP COLUMN rule_id;
